desc.v: This register configures how the CH1_POS_MODE/CH1_NEG_MODE settings will be modified when the control signal is low. 0: No modification; 1: Invert behavior (increase -> decrease, decrease -> increase); 2, 3: Inhibit counter modification.

This register configures how the CH1_POS_MODE/CH1_NEG_MODE settings will be modified when the control signal is high. 0: No modification; 1: Invert behavior (increase -> decrease, decrease -> increase); 2, 3: Inhibit counter modification.
This register sets the behavior when the signal input of channel 1 detects a positive edge. 1: Increase the counter; 2: Decrease the counter; 0, 3: No effect on counter.
This register sets the behavior when the signal input of channel 1 detects a negative edge. 1: Increase the counter; 2: Decrease the counter; 0, 3: No effect on counter.

This register configures how the CH0_POS_MODE/CH0_NEG_MODE settings will be modified when the control signal is low. 0: No modification; 1: Invert behavior (increase -> decrease, decrease -> increase); 2, 3: Inhibit counter modification.

This register configures how the CH0_POS_MODE/CH0_NEG_MODE settings will be modified when the control signal is high. 0: No modification; 1: Invert behavior (increase -> decrease, decrease -> increase); 2, 3: Inhibit counter modification.
This register sets the behavior when the signal input of channel 0 detects a positive edge. 1: Increase the counter; 2: Decrease the counter; 0, 3: No effect on counter.
This register sets the behavior when the signal input of channel 0 detects a negative edge. 1: Increase the counter; 2: Decrease the counter; 0, 3: No effect on counter.
This is the enable bit for unit n's thres1 comparator.
This is the enable bit for unit n's thres0 comparator.
This is the enable bit for unit n's thr_l_lim comparator.
This is the enable bit for unit n's thr_h_lim comparator.
This is the enable bit for unit n's zero comparator.
This is the enable bit for unit n's input filter.
This sets the maximum threshold, in APB_CLK cycles, for the filter. Any pulses with width less than this will be ignored when the filter is enabled.

c.v: (Descriptions of the channel 1 fields are as printed in the TRM, which words channel 1 POS/NEG modes as "Increment/Decrement the counter" instead of "Increase/Decrease".)
